scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-mediate/core && npm run build -w @agent-mediate/protocol && npm run build -w @agent-mediate/sdk && npm run build -w @agent-mediate/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:py && node --test --test-timeout=60000 "packages/*/test/*.test.ts"
